$comment: References that name a superseded version of another specification on purpose, keyed by the referencing slug, then by the <slug>/<version> named, each with the reason. Read by scripts/lib/stale-references.mjs. A Changes-from section, an enumeration that runs to the latest version, and `or later` are already exempt; an entry is for anything else meant. An entry no longer found is reported as stale.

rooms/records/get.rooms/records/put/0.1: Says which records carry no `blobs`: those written by `rooms/records/put/0.1`, which had none. Naming a later version would invert it.

rooms/records/list.rooms/records/put/0.1: Says which records carry no `blobs`: those written by `rooms/records/put/0.1`, which had none. Naming a later version would invert it.

documents.$comment: The same check over every *.md outside specs/ and every trust-tasks.toml under examples/ (#1129). `history` names documents that are about the past as a whole (glob → reason); `exceptions` names one deliberate reference (root-relative path → <slug>/<version> → reason). An exception no longer found is reported as stale; a history glob is a category and is not.

history.**/CHANGELOG*.md: Generated from the conventional commits that released each version; an entry records what was true when it shipped.
history.SPEC.md: Generated from the canonical framework repository at a pinned commit; its examples are fixed there, not here.
history.docs/adr/**: An architecture decision record is the decision as it was taken; a later record supersedes it, it is never edited.

CONTRIBUTING-SPECS.md.auth/refresh/0.1: The example of a spec targeting a framework before 0.4 that carries the Authorization section anyway, and of bearer possession as the whole authority; 0.2 targets 0.6 and adds a session-key proof, so it is neither.

bindings/https/0.3/spec.md.trust-task-discovery/0.1: Normative binding text naming the discovery Type URI a server registers; moving it changes the binding's conformance, so it is decided with the binding, not rewritten.

bindings/tsp/0.1/spec.md.trust-task-discovery/0.1: Normative binding text naming the discovery Type URI a consumer handles; moving it changes the binding's conformance, so it is decided with the binding, not rewritten.

docs/design-notes/task-control-and-corri.witness/session/submit/0.1: A quotation, attributed to the version it was taken from.

docs/design-notes/trust-ceremonies.md.vtc/join-requests/manifest/0.1: §13.1 records the join flow as it existed when the note was written (2026-08-09).
docs/design-notes/trust-ceremonies.md.vtc/join-requests/submit/0.1: §13.1 records the join flow as it existed when the note was written (2026-08-09).

examples/consumer-app/index-equivalence/.acl/list/0.1: The index-equivalence lock covers superseded versions on purpose (tests/index_equivalence.rs).
examples/consumer-app/index-equivalence/.sync/event/0.1: The index-equivalence lock covers a superseded version with no response on purpose (tests/index_equivalence.rs).
